beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part two of the H logo. Four moves about the space around the mark: clip-path wipe from the left, scale zoom from eight times down to fit, a rotation that holds, and a skew and shear. The H is nearly square — that geometry changes everything about how transforms read.

Your turn. Paste this: rotate the H logo on a spring from negative forty-five degrees, then hold the slow continuous rotation — and tell me at what rotational speed the H stops being a letter and starts being a shape. The answer changes your design options.
H logo, in motion. Part two. Liam, in for Bear.
